description: Haas, Thomas and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The collection provides time-resolved three-dimensional fields from pressure-driven boundary-layer simulations using KU Leuven's SPWind. Three roughness classes represent offshore and onshore conditions. Each has forty-five minutes of simulated wind sampled once per second, stored in fifteen-minute HDF5 segments. Python and MATLAB processing scripts are supporting utilities, not separately counted models. The fields are synthetic wind-energy inputs with the stated boundary-layer assumptions, not observed site climatology. Spatial grid details and applicability to particular turbine geometries are not specified in the brief metadata. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
